record.provider: EOSC EU Node — 50 GB personal + 500 GB group file storage per user, free credits from the European Commission

free_tier.stated: Access-policy table: File Storage (Personal) = 50 GB for Collaborator and Investigator; File Storage (Group) = 500 GB for Investigator only. Investigator also gets 'File Transfer 1TB/month'. Credits: Collaborator 1,000; Investigator '2,000 (individual) / 6,000 (group)', renewed automatically every three months and explicitly not top-up-able.

retention.stated: Credits are provided free of charge by the European Commission, are automatically renewed every three months, cannot be transferred to another person or between periods, and additional credits are not provided; services are ordered for a fixed period, so the allocation is not permanent.

egress.terms: Not metered; the node is EC-procured infrastructure. The binding constraint is the monthly 1 TB transfer allowance, which is the only hard number in the policy.

record.tooling: EOSC EU Node User Space web UI plus credit-metered service orders; no documented S3 endpoint. Treat as API-less until probed by an account holder.
record.chaining: The chaining hook is wallets, not accounts: 'When you create a group, a separate Group Wallet will automatically be generated. This wallet is independent of your personal wallet and comes pre-allocated with additional credits.' Investigator groups also carry the 500 GB group file storage. Many groups = many 500 GB pools, and the group storage is separate from the 50 GB personal pool.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: not stated. request-rate: 1 TB/month File Transfer is the sharpest published cap. Retention: credits 'cannot be transferred to another person or carried over between periods' and are 'automatically renewed every three months'; services are ordered for a fixed period and refunded pro rata if released, so nothing here is permanent. Gate: eduGAIN/ORCID/EU Login identity; access group is assigned automatically from your home organisation's affiliation data, and 'The EOSC EU Node does not support automatic transition between access groups.'

identity_cost.detail: eduGAIN / EU Login / eIDAS federated identity; access group is assigned automatically from affiliation information shared by the home organisation; only users from EU27 and Horizon Europe Associated Countries can get a role above Observer.

record.reliability_note: Credits are not top-up-able ('additional ones will not be provided to you') and do not carry over. A storage-heavy month silently stops you until the next quarter.

evidence.proved: paid 'free of charge (at the point of use) by the European Commission', 'automatically renewed every three months', 'additional ones will not be provided to you', 'When you create a group, a separate Group Wallet will automatically be generated ... pre-allocated with additional credits'

record.provider: eosc eu node as bulk storage

free_tier.stated: None. The access policy grants 50 GB personal and 500 GB group file storage with up to 1 TB upload transfer per month; credits refresh every 90 days and unused credits expire.

per_object_cap.stated: stated-absent: the access policy states storage and transfer quotas but no per-object size cap

retention.stated: Unused credits expire at the end of each 90-day period; reserved service environments are deactivated on credit or time expiration and reactivation needs a Helpdesk request

egress.terms: Large File Transfer allows up to 1TB upload per month; file transfer is capped at 1TB/month and charged 7 credits per month

record.interface_detail: the access policy lists S3 storage on Virtual Machines; File Sync and Share is provided through ownCloud and large transfers through FileSender and FTS
record.chaining: stated-absent: the access policy states no way to chain EOSC EU Node storage with other storage offers
record.reliability_note: Allocation provides 50 GB personal storage and 500 GB group storage with 1 TB per month transfer. Storage credits do not roll over and cannot be supplemented.
record.confidence_note: Rejection quoted from historical research records; unverified against live endpoints.

evidence.proved: 50 GB personal / 500 GB group, 1 TB/month transfer, credits that do not roll over and cannot be topped up. Reported as a candidate above for completeness

the access policy grants at most 500 GB group file storage
